VET NURSE HOME CARE is a passion for  Roseanne McGillivray RVN, a registered veterinary nurse with over 30yrs experience and dedication.
Her aim is to provide a friendly professional service for you and your pet by working together with yourself or, with a tailored plan with your veterinary surgeon. By bringing her love of practice nursing clinics & pet sitting into the comfort of your pets own home. Offering all aspects of you pets healthcare within the Vet Nurse Home Care Services and Cat & Small Dog Pet Sitting.  Covering Houston, Johnstone and the surrounds.
